description: This file defines build rules and device-specific configurations for building Chromium-based firmware images for Google WiFi devices, including kernel partitioning, bootloader configurations, and device metadata.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Build rule for creating a GPT partition table on the firmware image, copying, and merging temporary files.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Build rule to append the kernel image to the firmware image using dd with specified block size.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Build rule to generate a verified boot (vboot) image, transforming and replacing the original image with a signed one.

methods.name: Device/google_wifi
methods.description: Device-specific configuration for Google WiFi, including vendor, model, SOC, kernel suffix, image build pipeline, and associated packages.
